label: sim-hci-review-strong-1
assignment: Usability Review of a University Website
source: simulated demo student (persona: strong) run through the real platform
content: I am studying at a local university here, and using our student portal is sometimes very frustrating. First, for learnability, the navigation menu is hidden under a weird icon, so new students like me cannot find the 'exam schedule' easily. I remember my first week, I was looking for it for one hour and almost missed my mid-term date. A clear text label instead of an icon would fix this. Second, for flexibility, the portal does not let us save our course registration midway. If the internet disconnects, which happens often in my hostel, all my work disappears. We need a 'save draft' button. Third, for robustness, the error messages are very confusing. When I entered a wrong password, it just showed 'Error 404', which made me think the whole site was broken. It should say 'Invalid Password' so I know exactly what I did wrong. On the bright side, the portal has a very fast 'search' bar for finding library books. This shows good efficiency of use because I can get results in just one second without clicking many links.

viva.summary: The student demonstrates a deep understanding of usability heuristics, specifically regarding error handling and system flexibility. They are able to apply these concepts to practical scenarios and justify design improvements with clear, user-focused reasoning.

rubric.revise_next: Continue practicing how to map specific UI design patterns to usability heuristics to further strengthen your analytical skills.

questions.answer: Error 404 ka matlab hota hai page not found, toh user ko lagta hai system down hai ya koi bara technical fault hai. Ye message user ko guide nahi karta ke ghalti password ki hai, isliye user apni mistake recover nahi kar sakta.
questions.feedback: You correctly identified that 404 is a technical error that misleads users about their own input mistakes.
questions.prompt: You mentioned that the error message 'Error 404' makes you think the whole site is broken. Why does this specific error message fail to provide the robustness needed for a user to recover from their mistake?

questions.answer: System ko 'Invalid Course Code' ka message show karna chahiye, taake student ko pata chale ke usne ghalat code enter kiya hai.
questions.feedback: Your suggestion for a specific error message is spot on and directly addresses the robustness issue.
questions.prompt: If a student enters an invalid course code during registration, what specific error message should the system display instead of a generic error to ensure better robustness?

questions.answer: Main unhein batao ga ke bar bar form fill karna bohat frustrating hai, specially jab hostel ka internet disconnect ho jaye. Agar 'save draft' hoga to student ka time zaya nahi hoga aur system ki usability improve hogi, jo ke developer ke liye long-term mein better hai.
questions.feedback: You provided a strong, user-centered argument that effectively balances user frustration with system efficiency.
questions.prompt: If you had to explain the 'save draft' fix to a web developer who claims it is too expensive to implement, how would you justify its necessity based on your experience?
